name: Coffee, Banana & Peanut Butter Protein Smoothie
description: A thick iced breakfast smoothie with banana, peanut butter, vanilla whey, oats, milk and espresso - high in protein with enough carbohydrate and fat to make it a proper breakfast.
instructions: Pull a double espresso and allow it to cool for a few minutes.
Add the milk, banana, vanilla whey, rolled oats, peanut butter, espresso, a small pinch of salt and a generous handful of ice to a blender.
Blend on high until completely smooth and creamy.
If too thick, add a splash of milk; if too thin, add more ice.
Pour into a large glass and serve immediately.
